systems.name: 4.1 Pickup System
systems.notes: Random power‑up boxes scattered on track. Multiple pickups: speed boost, shield, projectile, oil, EMP.
tasks: Player inventory limited to 1 active item

systems.name: 4.2 Projectile & Hazard Weapons
systems.notes: Homeless missiles, energy blasts, oil puddles, and EMP pulses that affect nearby racers.
tasks: EMP burst that slows all nearby racers

systems.name: 4.3 Shield & Boost Mechanics
systems.notes: Temporary invincibility shield and turbo boost that can be chained.
